content: Hi how can i assist you today
Nearby Wi-Fi names match words on my mind. I saw ‘MOVE-NOW’ right when I considered moving.
SSIDs are set by whoever owns the router. Many are generic or playful. Did you notice multiple themed names in that building or just the one?
There were a few: ‘MOVE-NOW’ and ‘FIBER-FAST’ next to each other.
Adjacent SSIDs often come from the same provider’s installers or neighbors using templates. A scan at another location can show if similar words appear elsewhere without your thought in play.
At the cafe I saw ‘CAFE-GUEST’ and ‘NOTYOURWIFI’—less personal.
That contrast suggests environment and owners, not mind reading. A couple of scans in different places tend to make this visible.
